text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa…… Gotta hurry or sensei will scold
me~! Why did trash duty have to fall on
today……!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ……Ah,
are you okay? You look pretty stressed!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Class Rep Top Road! Sorry,
I was rushing…… The teacher called for me
about my upcoming interview……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then leave the trash to me!
Run along to sensei!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ……Really? Can I really leave it to you?
I'll make it up to you later, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
don't mention it! This'll only take a sec!
Give it your all in the interview!

Overhearing that exchange outside window
brought smile to my face during paperwork.

Finished paperwork and headed outside toward
grounds.

However,
upon passing garbage collection area――

Narita Top Road stood frozen.
Several crows had gathered on net guarding
garbage.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
…………Don't look at them,
just ignore them.
Step lightly……drop it and go……!

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caaaw.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……Phew———………… Okay, totally okay……

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caaaaaw.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, T-Trainer-san……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, well……one attacked me when I was little……
Even now, they still scare me……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……Crows are just really tough for me……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No,
you don't have to!
I'd feel bad making you do it!
choice_data_list: I'm fine with crows. Let me do it.
I'm fine with crows. Let me do it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……You saved me. Thank you so much, really.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aah~, so pathetic of me! If you hadn't come,
I'd probably still be frozen…… Thank you so
much!
choice_data_list: This isn't a big deal though……

text_block_list.text:
Admirable that she took on task and faced
her weakness,
but seeing her struggle earlier made me
wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……Well,
I took on the job.
I felt I had to see it through to the end.
choice_data_list: But the crows were unexpected, right?
But the crows were unexpected, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah…… Even so,
leaving trash anywhere else wasn't an
option.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
she trusted me when she handed it over.
She believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――So I wanted to live up to that trust.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard or scary it gets.
That's duty of someone people rely on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Living up to everyone's expectations makes
it all worth it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……Though saying that after needing your
rescue isn't very convincing, huh.
choice_data_list: No, I think it's a great mindset

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I won't just talk the talk,
I'll do my absolute best!

Strong sense of responsibility and drive to
improve were admirable――yet wishing she
would lean on others more remained.
